summary: The response noted that the road improvements suggested by the Perezes were already underway or proposed for local traffic needs, and that Milwaukee County was actively implementing a Transit Plan including purchase of the Transport Company and construction of park-and-ride lots.
text:
These improvements are already underway or proposed and are necessary to handle local traffic Please see the response to Witness 28 on page 248.
Milwaukee County is actively implementing a Transit Plan which included the purchase of the Transport Company and the construction of park and ride lots at various locations around the metropolitan area.
